facts.fact: INEC's head of ICT said in March 2025 that its voter registration system looks up a person's details in the NIDA database from the NIDA number entered at a registration centre.
facts.system: INEC voter registration integration with NIDA

TZA.note: Nothing on civil register and ID exchange.

facts.fact: INEC said in March 2025 it runs a Biometric Voter Registration Kit, now Android-based, feeding the Permanent Voter Register.

INEC's head of ICT said in March 2025 that voter registration is integrated with the NIDA database, so a voter's details are retrieved from NIDA by ID number; INEC on 23 August 2025 denied any integration with other systems for electoral purposes.

TZA.note: No NIDA enrolment count or share; 37.6 million is a voter count only in a link title.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who runs or owns NIDA.

facts.fact: INEC's head of ICT said in March 2025 that the voter registration system retrieves a person's details from the NIDA database by their NIDA number.

TZA.note: NIDA's own issuance and biometrics are not stated.
